title: Report highlights importance of Idaho’s small businesses | Business | idahocountyfreepress.com

facts.fact: The 2024 Small Businesses' Contribution to the Community report was produced by the Research Center of the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB).
facts.quote: whose Research Center produced the 2024 Small Businesses’ Contribution to the Community report

facts.fact: Suzanne Budge is Idaho state director for the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB).
facts.quote: said Suzanne Budge, Idaho state director for the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB)

facts.fact: The page's metadata lists the article's published time as 8 May 2025, while the visible article date reads Dec 31, 2024.
The report is a national snapshot of NFIB-member small business owners that is not broken down by state.
The NFIB member businesses described in the report employ between one and nine people and have gross sales of about $500,000 a year.
